title: CoinfloorEX relaunches as CoinFLEX
description: CoinfloorEX was spun out from Coinfloor Group and relaunched as CoinFLEX, a physically delivered crypto futures exchange.
notes: The source identifies February 2019 but not an exact day; 1 February is a sortable approximation.

title: CoinFLEX launches flexUSD
description: CoinFLEX launched flexUSD, which deployed underlying USDC into the exchange repo market and distributed interest to holders.
notes: Date follows the public launch announcement.

title: CoinFLEX suspends withdrawals
description: CoinFLEX halted withdrawals, citing extreme market conditions and uncertainty involving a counterparty.
notes: Normal withdrawal access did not resume on the initial timetable.

title: CoinFLEX permits limited withdrawals
description: Customers were allowed to withdraw up to ten percent of balances while most assets remained locked and flexUSD was excluded.
notes: Partial access was not completed repayment or normal withdrawal restoration.

title: Liquidity Technologies applies for restructuring
description: The CoinFLEX operating company applied to the Seychelles Supreme Court for a scheme of arrangement to reorganize creditor claims.
notes: The application date appears in later court materials; public reporting followed in August.

title: Seychelles court approves CoinFLEX scheme
description: The court approved the scheme, enabling creditor asset and equity allocations and the subsequent claims process.
notes: Approval completed the court stage, not all distributions, recoveries or litigation.
